method: 10 fresh-context agent roles, one model family, no human participants or Apple endorsement; locked initials before discussion

ui.reason: Numeric metrics and contextual punctuation pass fresh automated coverage; use tnum alone for aligned numeric UI. Native rendering remains untested.

headings.reason: Sampled weight/optical-size instances have finite bounds and consistent shaping; display appearance requires visual assessment.

body.reason: Technical feature checks pass, but this audit does not measure text spacing quality, legibility or reader performance.

sustained_reading.reason: No actual reader study, extended reading or fatigue assessment was performed.

ui.reason: 400 at 14 px has legible labels, punctuation and Russian/English rhythm. 100 is visibly faint at this raster size and 900 is dense; neither extreme should be the default. Alphanumeric identifiers need extra care for O/0.

headings.reason: At 40 px all three weights have coherent RU/EN proportions and clear word silhouettes; no obvious collisions or closed counters in these samples.

body.reason: 400 at 18 px is convincing in the short RU/EN samples; counters and word spacing remain clear. Weight 100 is delicate and 900 emphatic, appropriate stylistic extremes rather than demonstrated drawing defects.

sustained_reading.reason: The regular short paragraphs look promising, but a few lines of visual review cannot establish comfort over sustained reading.

ui.reason: Suitable to continue limited 16px/500 interface trials. Actual checkbox/button sample uses Tabuna, but system-font page chrome does not validate broader UI deployment; adaptive native integration and runtime assistive-technology testing remain unverified.

headings.reason: Hierarchy and moderate default weights are reasonable. Large headline use remains provisional pending large-text reflow and rendered glyph/spacing review; hero nowrap is a concrete adaptation risk.

body.reason: 1rem/400 static paragraphs and 18px/400 body preset with 1.6–1.65 leading provide a reasonable starting setup; source settings alone do not establish font legibility.

sustained_reading.reason: Only two short demonstration paragraphs; no long-form task, controlled reader evidence, low-vision evaluation, or fatigue measure. Cannot approve sustained reading from HIG-oriented source inspection.

ui.reason: Regular 400 Russian labels at 12–20 px remain legible with matched opsz. Thin 100 at 12–16 px has very low stroke coverage; heavy 900 is usable for short emphasis, not a default text weight.

headings.reason: At 24–96 px the tested Cyrillic constructions and diacritics remain recognizable at 100, 400 and 900; no visible broken joins or counter collapse in the inspected samples.

body.reason: Russian paragraphs at 14 and 18 px / weight 400 are readable and have coherent texture. This is a short visual inspection, not a reading study.

sustained_reading.reason: Four-line paragraphs do not establish long-session readability or fatigue; no human reading test was performed.

ui.reason: Numeric UI at weight 400–700, opsz 9–14 is clear; tnum stabilizes timers and right-aligned fixed-precision numbers. Do not use weight 100 at 16px for critical values.

headings.reason: 32px numeric samples are legible across sampled axes; thin 100/128 has low emphasis and must suit contrast and size.

body.reason: Inline currency and decimals at 16px, usual axes are legible. This review does not assess full prose.

sustained_reading.reason: Numeric samples cannot establish long-form reading comfort.

ui.reason: Independent 16px labels, controls, dates and currency are readable with no obvious broken spacing; blind UI pairs show no robust difference.

headings.reason: 36px/500 Russian and English headings have coherent rhythm and open counters; no robust blind preference at 48px/500.

body.reason: Five-line English and Russian paragraphs at 16px/400 remain visually even and easily parsed at inspected scale.

sustained_reading.reason: An agent inspection of short passages cannot measure fatigue, reading speed, comprehension or long-duration comfort.

raw_verdicts.ui: Conditional pass: legible short controls at 16px/500; enlarged narrow layout fails.
raw_verdicts.headings: Pass at normal desktop/mobile sizes: clear hierarchy and open forms; enlarged hero fails reflow.
raw_verdicts.body: Pass for the two supplied short Russian paragraphs at 16px/1.65 and body preset 18px/1.6.
raw_verdicts.sustained_reading: Not established: supplied article is too short for fatigue or long-form evaluation.
raw_verdicts.tables: Pass at ordinary tested size: 14.4px figures align, four weight rows remain readable.
raw_verdicts.release: Suitable for continued prototype use; resolve enlarged narrow layout before treating demo as robust accessible integration.

raw_verdicts.ui: Conditional pass for 400/500 at 14–18px; 12px recognizable but less robust. Do not use 100 for essential small UI. 900 only brief emphasis. Platform validation outstanding.
raw_verdicts.headings: Small headings at 16–18px 400/500/900 readable. Larger heading sizes not tested; Thin heading approval outside scope.
raw_verdicts.body: Conditional pass for short RU/EN text at 16–18px 400/500. Thin and 900 unsuitable as default body in this matrix.
raw_verdicts.sustained_reading: Not established: short isolated lines only; no extended reading or participant test.

raw_verdicts.ui: conditional; labels visually usable, Il1 distinction needs intended-size checks
raw_verdicts.headings: provisional visual pass for sampled lines; no comparative character winner
